name: Sheldon, Hospital Superintendent v. Reynolds; and Reynolds v. Sheldon, Hospital Superintendent

court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

parties: Sheldon, Hospital Superintendent v. Reynolds; and Reynolds v. Sheldon, Hospital Superintendent.

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. N. D. Tex. Motions of Perry Wayne Reynolds for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted, judgment vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of O’Connor v. Donaldson, ante, p. 563. Reported below: 381 F. Supp. 1374.

casebody.head_matter:
June 30, 1975
Vacated and Remanded on Appeal
No. 74-726.
No. 74-5743.
Sheldon, Hospital Superintendent v. Reynolds; and Reynolds v. Sheldon, Hospital Superintendent.
Mk. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of cases in which orders hereinafter reported were announced on this date,
